title: Baraat laut gayi... dulha ne kyun mod liya rath?
hooks: Baraat laut gayi... dulha ne kyun mod liya rath?
Ek cheekh ne badal di 22ve Tirthankara ki zindagi
Vivaah ka rath kyun gaya wapas? Karuna ka faisla
hook_why: Opens with the shocking visual of a wedding procession reversing — immediate curiosity, names the event (baraat) and the surprise (dulha turned back) in first 5 words, matches the 'confession/urgent interruption' hook pattern that wins on Shorts.
metaphor: A single conch shell (shankha) glowing on a white marble pedestal — each scene adds a layer (wedding canopy, animal cries, open cage, mountain peak) until the conch becomes the emblem of a life turned toward liberation.
mechanism: Baraat palace se nikli, dulha Neminath rath par sawar
Raste mein jaanwaron ki cheekhein sunai di
Sarathi ne bataya: yeh sab vivaah bhoj ke liye kaid hain
Neminath ko karuna aayi, faisla liya
Saare baade khulwa diye, har jeev azad kiya
Rath mod liya, wapas mahal ki taraf
Rajya, mahal, byah sab chhod diya
Girnar parvat pahuche, tapasya shuru ki
Rajul ne bhi diksha lee, sadhvi bani

caption:
Baraat laut gayi... dulha ne kyun mod liya rath? 🐘

Ek cheekh ne badal di 22ve Tirthankara Neminath ki zindagi. Karuna itni badi ki mahal, rajya, byah... sab chhod diya.

Aap us pal hote toh kya karte?

claims.claim: Lord Neminath is the 22nd Tirthankara of Jainism
claims.basis: Trishashti-shalaka-purusha-charitra by Hemachandra; Wikipedia; Jain tradition

claims.claim: Neminath was on his way to marry Princess Rajul (Rajimati) when he heard animal cries
claims.basis: Trishashti-shalaka-purusha-charitra; Uttaradhyayana Sutra; Kalpa Sutra; inviteeq.com; jainamjayati.com

claims.claim: The animals were penned for the wedding feast
Neminath freed all animals and turned his chariot back, renouncing the world
He went to Mount Girnar, attained kevala jnana and moksha
Princess Rajul also took diksha and became a nun

figures.name: Lord Neminath (22nd Tirthankara)
